input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Raw magical heavy four-legged stone beast, squat broad body, blunt mineral horns and tall angular thorn-like back plates, ochre mineral seams, heavy blunt feet, small armored head. Charging wedge silhouette; no gore. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows: TEN complete poses, same anatomical scale, no text. Read left to right: poses 1-4 QUICK FLINCH: 1 ready; 2 head and shoulders jerk backward visibly; 3 legs catch balance; 4 fully recovered ready. Poses 5-10 HEAVY STAGGER: 5 ready; 6 abrupt head and torso recoil; 7 deepest hunched recoil and visibly lost balance; 8 legs splay and bend to catch weight; 9 pushing back toward ready; 10 fully recovered ready. Show clear torso articulation and varied leg support; not repeated standing duplicates. Keep FOUR animal feet and natural creature anatomy, no rearing, no human arms. No falling or lying poses in this sheet. The difference between ready and peak recoil must read at small game size. Wide empty gutters, no clipped parts. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. Keep the approved BLUE illuminated mineral seams as well as ochre cracks. The approved image outranks any conflicting written color description.

arguments.Prompt: Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy game character animation sheet on solid uniform vivid pure magenta background (#FF00FF). Character identity and anatomy matching the references: a raw magical heavy four-legged stone beast, squat broad quadruped body, small armored head with blunt mineral horns, tall angular thorn-like stone back plates along its spine, heavy blunt columnar feet, ochre mineral cracks and glowing blue illuminated mineral seams, stone-armored charging wedge silhouette. Animal only, strictly four legs, no humanoid features. View: Elevated 55-degree orthographic angle, front-right three-quarter perspective facing diagonally towards the viewer and image right. Grid layout: Exactly 5 columns and 2 rows forming 10 distinct animation poses across a 5x2 grid, identical anatomical scale throughout, wide empty pure magenta gutters between cells. Row 1 (Poses 1-4 Quick Flinch, Pose 5 Ready): Pose 1 ready quadruped stance; Pose 2 quick flinch with head and shoulders jerked backward; Pose 3 front legs brace and catch balance; Pose 4 fully recovered ready stance; Pose 5 ready stance. Row 2 (Poses 6-10 Heavy Stagger): Pose 6 abrupt heavy recoil as head and torso jerk back; Pose 7 deepest hunched recoil with visibly lost balance and pushed back torso; Pose 8 legs splayed wide and bent deep catching heavy weight; Pose 9 pushing forward recovering stance; Pose 10 fully recovered ready stance. Hand-painted dark fantasy style, sculpted mineral planes, cool upper-left light, glowing blue mineral seams, crisp clean borders against flat solid vivid magenta background. No panel borders, no text, no ground plane.
